The largest reuse correspondences occur with *Kusalattika, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 16.25), sharing 13 matches (3,152 characters; longest match §1.1_2–3.1 to §19.1–20.1), *Kusalattika, Pītittika* (Patthana 23.6), *Kusalattika, Hetusahetukadukādi* (Patthana 22.4), and *Kusalattika, Vitakkattika* (Patthana 23.5) [DharmaNexus]. Notably high-similarity matches also link it to *Kusalattika, Atītārammaṇattika* (Patthana 17.18; similarity score 0.90 across segments §0.1–3.1) and another section of *Kusalattika, Parittārammaṇattika* (Patthana 23.12) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language alignments with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan texts are recorded above the match threshold [DharmaNexus].
